note.summary: This chunk explains how Structures and Buildings Allowance (SBA) interacts with Capital Gains Tax computations on disposal of land, leases and demolition of qualifying buildings/structures. It covers freehold disposals (SBA added to consideration), leasehold disposals (wasting asset rules, apportionment between SBA and non-SBA expenditure), demolition treated as a deemed disposal (with an irrevocable election to opt out), and capital contributions to qualifying buildings. It gives worked examples and specifies where and how to make claims/elections on the SA return (Capital Gains summary SA108, box 20 code 'OTH'/'MUL', box 54).

note.summary: HS292 explains Capital Gains Tax treatment of disposals of land and leases for the 2025 to 2026 tax year, to support completion of the Capital Gains Tax summary (SA108) pages. It covers part-disposal rules for grants of long and short leases (with worked examples), premiums partly chargeable to Income Tax on short leases, capital sums received during a lease, assignment/surrender of leases, lease extensions, and compulsory purchase rules including the date of disposal. UK residents disposing of UK residential property with a CGT liability must report and pay within 60 days of completion (for completions on or after 27 October 2021); non-residents are referred to HS307.

note.summary: This chunk (HS292) explains Capital Gains Tax treatment of compulsory purchase compensation, including small part disposal relief, rollover relief where compensation is reinvested in new land, apportionment of compensation between land, disturbance and severance/injurious affection, and alternative and statutory bases for apportioning cost on part disposals. It also covers when land valuations are needed, special rules for 31 March 1982 valuations and jointly owned land, and the CG34 post-transaction valuation check service. All examples reference dates in 2025 and instruct taxpayers on how to claim reliefs via the SA108 Capital Gains summary boxes 8, 20, 28, 53 and 54.
